title: Great authentic cooking,...
text: Great authentic cooking, excellent instruction and a lot of fun! All the dishes tasted incredible. Highly recommend
author: Thomas_S

title: Highlight of our trip!
text: This experience was a highlight of our trip. The chef/host is knowledgeable and engaging and entertaining. The instruction is excellent, and the free-flowing Cava put all of our classmates in a great mood. Two hours of non-stop fun that inspired us to cook more paella at home.
author: Frank_B

title: Vacation Activity
text: We had an amazing time at the Paella Club! We cooked several different types and had lots of delicious cava and wine! Such a fun and informative event. All ingredients are local so a great farm to table experience. Can’t say enough good things about the owner and this place. A must do while in Barcelona!
author: Christy_T

title: Great food and non stop laughs
text: At the last minute we booked the Amuse Bouche 2 hour cooking class which is a quicker Paella making class and we're so glad we did! From the moment we stepped into the Building we knew we were in for a treat. Kevin was the absolute best at leading us through the Paella class and made the afternoon one we will never forget. The food was delicious and we've never laughed so hard in our lives. It's truly an experience you don't want to miss.
author: amandamZ4657XW

title: SO much fun!  What a...
text: SO much fun!  What a great experience.  Lucia was an awesome teacher and she sent us the recipes so we can make the paellas at home! It was great meeting other people.  Loved that we got to eat what we made.  And we were treated with an appetizer and a dessert (and lots of wine!) as well.  I highly recommend this experience.
author: MarianneR_C

title: Cool!!!
text:
We did the masterclass “Experience Paella” and were thrilled both for what we learned and for the lively atmosphere and spectacular taste of the paella we prepared, as well as for the generous wine that was offered to us, with endless reviews.

The lesson is taught in English by a chef who has also worked with Gordon Ramsay and at the court of Queen Elizabeth II of England. Spectacular.

The place has a small shop where you can buy the right ingredients to repeat the paella once home.

The Paella Club was the most beautiful and engaging experience we had in Barcelona!
author: Evelina G

title: Loved this experience!
text:
Fantastic experience!
Great fun, sociable, learned lots, plenty of wine, staff were brilliant, lovely shred dining experience after we cooked - highly recommend!
author: Karenmcleod

title: Delicious and fun
text: Unbelievably fun experience. The paella making was so fun-all different kinds. A lot of laughs. Teachers were incredible and so easy to follow. The room where we cooked and ate was clean. Just a great way to experience food in Barcelona and meet people from all over the world!!  So well done!!
author: crlevison

title: Highly recommend this experience
text: Outstanding!  Exceeded expectation... We had fun.. and made GREAT Paella.. Our friends cant wait for us to make it for them!
author: Betty65SeattleWA

title: So fun and delicious!
text: The chef, set up, explanations, and activity choreography was outstanding and fun. The paella we made was delicious. They managed my food restriction perfectly too. An experience well worth doing.
author: BorneoMel
